fixed.binding: c001..c004 -> [Mgr]; r001..r004 -> [Robot] (same for every m and every family)

families.OR: m lines; line j = A_j || B_j (one atom each); 2m atoms; expected clauses before/after dedup = 2^m / 2^m
families.AND: same m lines and atoms with || replaced by &&; 2m atoms; 1 clause
families.DUP: OR body in two identical roles MgrA, MgrB, consumers bound to both (Q=2, separate family); expanded reads 2*2^m, final alternatives per consumer 2^m
families.REF: existing sweep threshold condition (Biped && battery<=30 || Wheeled && battery<=20): 4 atoms, 2 clauses

stop_rules.rule: Configs run in increasing m. A config whose child process exceeds per_config_wall_s or peak_rss_bytes is killed by the parent watchdog and recorded as status=aborted with reason, elapsed and last RSS. A config whose warm-up full pipeline (parse+check+generate) or any single timed call exceeds per_call_s is recorded as status=stopped (the observed call time is kept, remaining repetitions are not run). After an aborted or stopped config, no larger m of the same family is started. If the next extension step's projected time (from the quadratic growth of check/generate in clause count, i.e. x16 per +2 lines) exceeds per_config_wall_s, the step is still attempted once and stopped by the rules above, so the stop point is observed, not projected.
stop_rules.application: parent driver (major1/driver.py) launches one child per config, polls child RSS with `ps -o rss=` every 0.1 s and kills on RSS or wall overrun; per_call_s is enforced inside the child by checking each timed call after it returns (a call is not interrupted mid-way; the per-config wall limit bounds it). A deliberate-overrun dry run (tiny limits) proves both kill paths before measurement.
stop_rules.note: These are measurement budget limits of this experiment, not input limits supported or recommended by the product.

semantic_cases: per config: every robot x battery set x zone set (battery set = 0, 30, 100 and for every threshold index k the four boundary values 40+k, 41+k, 20-k, 19-k; zones = storage, dock0, dock<kmax>, yard) plus, for every line j, one case that falsifies exactly line j (all other lines true) -- included in the per-config wall budget
